title: 目が離せないお嬢様たち

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While eating in the cafeteria, I overhear Mejiro Bright and Fine Motion having a discussion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A message from a prince?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes. This morning I received an email from someone claiming to be the prince of a certain country.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Apparently, he has a surplus of wealth and is searching for someone who will use that money effectively.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so he's a philanthropist? But I wonder if a member of royalty would send an email like that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So, did you reply?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, I refused his offer. There's no way I can accept money from a complete stranger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But then I received another message saying the prince was involved in an accident…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My, what are the chances!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Apparently, he was seriously injured and is requesting assistance with his medical costs.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Hold on. Wasn't this the same fellow who had so much money he wanted to give it away?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: He said all his money burned up in the accident.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so all his funds were in cash? And this must have been a mighty fire to have destroyed all that capital. It's strange that I haven't seen any news about it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to remain silent any longer, I intrude upon their conversation.
choice_data_list: It's all a bunch of lies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: What? Is that right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I thought it all sounded a smidge too convenient! His claim of being a prince, then getting hurt in an accident—so it was all a big scam, then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, it seems so obvious now! Well, that's an enormous relief.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It means there was no accident, and that no one was hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite almost being deceived by this "prince," Mejiro Bright still feels a great sense of relief.
choice_data_list: You really are a kind person.
You need to learn a little more about how the world works.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The news about the accident felt so sudden that I was simply overcome with worry. I didn't think to question it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's a fine shame there are people out there trying to take advantage of that sort of good will. Let's be sure to stay vigilant, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely! Thank you very much for your advice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: How the world works… I see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: At the very least, you should be able to tell whether an email is a scam or not.
choice_data_list: It's best to ignore emails from people you don't know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That makes sense! And it sounds much better than checking each and every message one by one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I appreciate your advice. I'll definitely be more careful from now on!
choice_data_list: You should also change your email address if possible.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Indeed! It'd be quite the bother if that false prince contacted you again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You're absolutely right! …So how would one do that?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Uhh, I'm sorry, I don't know either! My security team handles that sort of thing for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I end up helping Mejiro Bright change her email address.
